crossRefs.note: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Ahithophel
people.line: David's counselor who joined Absalom's rebellion, later committed suicide

people.name: Hushai
people.line: David's friend and advisor who helped him during Absalom's rebellion.

translations.web: Hushai said to Absalom, “The counsel that Ahithophel has given this time is not good.”
translations.bsb: Hushai replied, “This time the advice of Ahithophel is not sound.”
translations.kjv: And Hushai said unto Absalom, The counsel that Ahithophel hath given is not good at this time.
translations.asv: And Hushai said unto Absalom, The counsel that Ahithophel hath given this time is not good.
